title: A SLOW PC IS TOLD WHERE THE LEVERS ARE
why: From the stress run of 2026-10-02: on a weak machine the frame runs long and nothing says why or what to do. When more than half of ten seconds of raid frames run over 25 ms, the game says once a session that Settings has Render resolution and Effects to lighten the load. The raw frame gap is measured, so a Frame cap is not read as slow.
now: If the game runs slowly on a PC, it says once where the Settings levers are.

edits.replacement:
var gap0=ts-lastTs; var dt=clamp(gap0/1000,0,.05); lastTs=ts;   // v16.xx: gap0 is the raw frame gap, for perfNote
  if(state==='raid'&&G&&!G.over&&!G.sim&&!(CFG.fpsCap>0)) perfNote(gap0);   // v16.xx: a slow PC is told where the levers are
